Original source citations are preserved, not independently re-audited in this extension. New resource inspections cover their stated schemas, access or design role; complete equation-specific literature reviews and novelty claims are pending. Catalog-wide word count is not a quality score. Domain models can inform a mission but do not automatically fit every mission in that domain.

Independent scientific review, actual dataset evaluation beyond descriptive catalog aggregation, complete implementations, human studies, hardware/environment testing and operational pilots remain pending. NASA-level certification, endorsement or flight readiness is not claimed.

The additional 150 RT modules are a separate staged assessment curriculum, linked to existing mission IDs. They are not another 150 completed products. Eight typed public intelligence cards use six sources and eleven narrow claims. Six added tests check learning progression, existing-mission references, claim/source integrity, byline classification, persona/operator distinction and count separation. No hosted offensive repositories or tools were acquired or run. Actor-dossier coverage is narrow and historical; it does not establish current patch state, personal identity or complete threat coverage.

# APOLLO · Mission Systems & Architecture

**Evidence:** Proposed domain research framework. The equations below are author-defined candidate models, not measured findings or requirements quoted from standards.

**Research focus:** Mission loss in service-minutes; dependency uncertainty and correlated failures.

## Governing model

```text
L = sum_f w_f integral_0^T [1-q_f(t)] dt
```

q_f(t) is delivered fraction in [0,1]; weights w_f sum to one; T and integral use minutes. Compare architectures at equal demand and recovery staffing.

**Competing models:** Static asset tiers; independent-component availability; graph with no common-cause node.

**Required record schema:** Typed service inventory, dependency confidence, demand trace, failover delay, repair duration, scenario identifier. Extend the schema with provenance digest, units, coverage window, collection permission, missingness reason and transformation revision. Use explicit null values for missing observations; do not turn missing into zero.

## Evaluation contract

Measure Recovery loss difference, time to essential function, 95% interval, model calibration. Freeze a mission-specific primary endpoint and acceptable resource cost before tuning. Compare the candidate and baseline on the same scenario/partition. Include a no-intervention or null fixture to detect accidental leakage. Report uncertainty at the independent unit—scenario, channel, device or team—and analyze the worst-performing subgroup rather than relying on a portfolio average.

**Adverse cases:** Shared power or identity failure; delayed failover; demand burst; undocumented edge.

**Graduate challenges:** Missing dependencies; dependence between repairs; operator interventions; topology uncertainty. For each challenge, distinguish a limitation of the estimator from a limitation of available evidence. Ask whether the parameter is identifiable, whether the mechanism transfers to a new environment and which observation could distinguish rival explanations.

**Resource plan:** Discrete-event model, graph inventory, one workstation, systems engineer and independent mission owner. Before implementation, produce a concrete bill of materials, input size, memory/storage estimate, runtime bound and personnel-hours estimate. No universal cost or readiness claim is made here.

## Applicable data and its limits

[LANL Comprehensive Multi-Source Cyber-Security Events](https://csr.lanl.gov/data/cyber1/). Authentication/process/DNS/flow correlation and missing-observation studies. Split chronologically and by entity; the small red-team label set is incomplete; absence of a label is not a negative truth. Failed-auth inclusion is conditional on at least one successful auth. Resource budget: 58 days, approximately 12 GB compressed; plan streaming aggregation rather than full RAM loading. Current status: landing page and schema inspected. Access/rights: CC0 waiver stated by publisher; human-subject and public-release approvals documented.

**Evidence:** Proposed domain research framework. The equations below are author-defined candidate models, not measured findings or requirements quoted from standards.

```text
G(authorized AND fresh AND valid -> permitted) AND G(NOT authorized -> NOT permitted)
```

G is the temporal always operator. This is an illustrative policy, not a complete security property; prove freshness and authorization predicates separately. Model liveness under explicit fairness assumptions.

# KEPLER · Network Observability

**Evidence:** Proposed domain research framework. The equations below are author-defined candidate models, not measured findings or requirements quoted from standards.

**Research focus:** Partial observation under time uncertainty, benign drift and rare-event prevalence.

## Governing model

```text
z_t = (x_t-median(x_train))/(1.4826 MAD(x_train)); alert = I[z_t>tau]
```

x is an aggregate count or scalar; freeze training window and threshold before testing. MAD needs an explicit zero-scale fallback. Correlated samples invalidate naive per-row confidence intervals.

**Competing models:** Fixed global threshold; rolling mean/std; single-sensor detector.

**Required record schema:** Event time, ingest time, sensor pseudonym, aggregation interval, event count, missingness mask, maintenance label. Extend the schema with provenance digest, units, coverage window, collection permission, missingness reason and transformation revision. Use explicit null values for missing observations; do not turn missing into zero.

## Evaluation contract

Measure Precision-recall, false alerts per sensor-hour, event detection delay, missingness-conditioned recall. Freeze a mission-specific primary endpoint and acceptable resource cost before tuning. Compare the candidate and baseline on the same scenario/partition. Include a no-intervention or null fixture to detect accidental leakage. Report uncertainty at the independent unit—scenario, channel, device or team—and analyze the worst-performing subgroup rather than relying on a portfolio average.

**Adverse cases:** Drop sensor blocks; change benign mean; burst legitimate demand; skew clocks; lower anomaly prevalence.

**Graduate challenges:** Nonrandom missingness; time skew; base-rate collapse; legitimate operating change. For each challenge, distinguish a limitation of the estimator from a limitation of available evidence. Ask whether the parameter is identifiable, whether the mechanism transfers to a new environment and which observation could distinguish rival explanations.

**Resource plan:** Offline LANL aggregates or owned OpenTelemetry traces; no live scanning or packet injection. Before implementation, produce a concrete bill of materials, input size, memory/storage estimate, runtime bound and personnel-hours estimate. No universal cost or readiness claim is made here.

## Applicable data and its limits

[LANL Comprehensive Multi-Source Cyber-Security Events](https://csr.lanl.gov/data/cyber1/). Authentication/process/DNS/flow correlation and missing-observation studies. Split chronologically and by entity; the small red-team label set is incomplete; absence of a label is not a negative truth. Failed-auth inclusion is conditional on at least one successful auth. Resource budget: 58 days, approximately 12 GB compressed; plan streaming aggregation rather than full RAM loading. Current status: landing page and schema inspected. # OSIRIS · Forensic Science and Evidence Integrity

**Evidence:** Proposed domain research framework. The equations below are author-defined candidate models, not measured findings or requirements quoted from standards.

**Research focus:** Observation validity and intervals of event ordering.

## Governing model

```text
t_i in [observed_i-offset_bound_i, observed_i+offset_bound_i]
```

Infer A before B only when upper(A)<lower(B); overlapping intervals are indeterminate. A timeline order does not establish cause. Acquisition errors remain separate from clock errors.

**Competing models:** Sort timestamps directly; assume absent record means event absent.

**Required record schema:** Artifact digest, source, acquisition version, observation window, timestamp bound, chain-of-custody step, known fixture truth. ```

A is age of information in seconds. Reset only on verified reception of a newer state. Include clock uncertainty, key expiry, storage limits and intermittent power in extensions.

**Competing models:** Always-connected policy; transmit-at-every-step scheduler; unverified receipt.

**Required record schema:** Relative mission time, contact flag, queue bytes, evidence age, power mode, verified digest, rollback state. Extend the schema with provenance digest, units, coverage window, collection permission, missingness reason and transformation revision. Use explicit null values for missing observations; do not turn missing into zero.

## Evaluation contract

Measure Verified delivery fraction, age p95, energy proxy, recovery latency, evidence storage. Freeze a mission-specific primary endpoint and acceptable resource cost before tuning. Compare the candidate and baseline on the same scenario/partition. Include a no-intervention or null fixture to detect accidental leakage. Report uncertainty at the independent unit—scenario, channel, device or team—and analyze the worst-performing subgroup rather than relying on a portfolio average.

**Adverse cases:** Missed contact; delayed receipt; key expiry in blackout; storage full; reset during staging.

**Graduate challenges:** Availability vs freshness; cosmic faults vs software faults; limited energy; no trusted wall clock. For each challenge, distinguish a limitation of the estimator from a limitation of available evidence. Ask whether the parameter is identifiable, whether the mechanism transfers to a new environment and which observation could distinguish rival explanations.

**Resource plan:** NASA cFS source as architecture study; synthetic contacts, emulated payload; passive RF resources only. ## Applicable data and its limits

[NASA Core Flight System](https://github.com/nasa/cFS). Offline remote-operation state models and assurance traceability. **Evidence class:** Proposed. No operational benefit or complete implementation is claimed. **Domain:** Mission Systems & Architecture.

## Thesis

A dependency model with shared-cause nodes predicts service loss better than independent availability estimates.

## Model and mechanism

Sample latent causes Z_k; component survival is conditional on Z, not independent marginal availability. Evaluate L = integral(1-delivered_fraction)dt with separate mission weights.

Create paired synthetic architectures sharing power, identity and backup dependencies. Fit only on training scenarios and compare held-out correlated outages with matched component failure counts.

# 001 · Function-First Risk Atlas

**Status:** Proposed research mission; no field effectiveness established. **Research orbit:** APOLLO.

[Original proposal](../../atlas/01-mission-systems-and-architecture.md#m001) · [Domain model](../domains/01.md) · [Protocol](../METHOD.md)

## Preserved thesis and mechanism

**Hypothesis.** Mapping mission functions to dependencies predicts outage consequence better than asset criticality labels. **Design.** Build a typed graph with functions, service dependencies, recovery paths, control owners, and confidence intervals on each edge. Estimate consequence as the expected fraction of mission demand unmet over time, not a single asset score. **Evidence.** Start with an authorized service inventory and dependency interviews; synthesize failures rather than interrupt production. **Test.** Compare graph predictions against tabletop adjudications and historical outage timelines using rank correlation and calibrated prediction intervals. A useful prototype must outperform a blinded asset-tier baseline across held-out scenarios. **Boundary.** Unknown dependencies remain explicit and enlarge uncertainty; the atlas must not imply that a diagram is complete. Sources: [NIST CSF 2.0](https://www.nist.gov/cyberframework), [NIST SP 800-160 Vol. 1 Rev. 1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/160/v1/r1/final).

## Expanded experiment specification

Treat the statement “Mapping mission functions to dependencies predicts outage consequence better than asset criticality labels.” as a hypothesis with a comparator and a population, not as a demonstrated benefit. Implement the precise mechanism described above; preserve the original evidence boundary and endpoint. Use the domain model to state variables and units, but justify which assumptions apply to this particular mechanism rather than copying the model mechanically.

**Observation contract:** collect only the fields needed to estimate this mission's endpoint. Candidate domain fields are Typed service inventory, dependency confidence, demand trace, failover delay, repair duration, scenario identifier. Bind every record to source/version, valid-time interval, missingness reason and a fixture or collection permission. The domain resource is LANL Comprehensive Multi-Source Cyber-Security Events; its applicability is a candidate starting point, not an assertion that every field required by this mission exists there. When fields or labels are absent, design a synthetic or owned-system fixture and report the gap.

**Baseline and falsification:** use the original comparison stated above and at least one applicable simple baseline from Static asset tiers; independent-component availability; graph with no common-cause node. Match information, tuning, observation and resource budgets. Define an absolute acceptance floor and minimum meaningful improvement before collecting the final test results. Reject the thesis if the benefit disappears on an untouched partition, if the resource-normalized baseline dominates it or if a declared invariant fails. Choose numerical floors with the mission owner; this dossier does not invent measured thresholds.

**Adverse-case matrix:** Shared power or identity failure; delayed failover; demand burst; undocumented edge. Choose the cases relevant to this mechanism and explain any exclusion. Add a negative control in which the intervention should have no effect. Preserve ambiguous outcomes instead of assigning unsupported truth labels.

**Graduate investigation:** Missing dependencies; dependence between repairs; operator interventions; topology uncertainty. Write a rival explanation for any apparent improvement; identify the smallest additional observation that distinguishes it from the proposed mechanism. Perform a sensitivity analysis over uncertain assumptions and a leave-one-environment/scenario-out evaluation. A performance difference within a synthetic fixture establishes only behavior of that fixture.

**Review artifacts:** model/assumption ledger; versioned input contract; baseline implementation; preregistered endpoint; adverse-case results with uncertainty; resource-use record; negative findings; independent review notes. The practical starting budget is Discrete-event model, graph inventory, one workstation, systems engineer and independent mission owner. Independent reviewer sign-off remains pending.

# 131 · Owned-Asset Exposure Census

**Status:** Proposed research mission; no field effectiveness established. **Research orbit:** NEOWISE.

[Original proposal](../../atlas/14-authorized-exposure-intelligence.md#m131) · [Domain model](../domains/14.md) · [Protocol](../METHOD.md)

## Preserved thesis and mechanism

**Thesis.** Reconciliation of an organization's approved inventory with permitted external observations can reveal forgotten owned services. **Proposed system.** A scope registry stores approved domains, ranges, legal owner, data sources, observation dates, and collection limits. Compare internal CMDB/API inventory with licensed or public service metadata, retaining raw-source freshness and confidence. **Evidence and test.** On a synthetic portfolio or explicitly owned assets, measure precision/recall of owner matching, unknown-service review time, and stale-record rate against manual inventory. **Boundary.** The project must never infer authorization from mere internet visibility; do not scan third-party systems. ## Preserved thesis and mechanism

**Thesis.** Small reversible experiments can reveal which emerging defenses merit investment before an organization commits to a large rollout. **Proposed system.** Maintain an option register with hypothesis, small-scope experiment, maximum cost, stop condition, scale condition, safety guardrail, and owner. Update belief in each option only from traceable results; archive abandoned options with the reason. **Evidence and test.** In a simulated investment cycle, compare regret, sunk cost, and time to identify a useful candidate against a one-shot procurement decision. **Boundary.** A portfolio is not permission to expose production to experiments; use isolated pilots and separate approval for deployment. Anchors: [NIST CSF 2.0](https://www.nist.gov/publications/nist-cybersecurity-framework-csf-20), [NIST SP 800-55 Vol. 2](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/55/v2/final).

## Expanded experiment specification

Treat the statement “Small reversible experiments can reveal which emerging defenses merit investment before an organization commits to a large rollout.” as a hypothesis with a comparator and a population, not as a demonstrated benefit. Implement the precise mechanism described above; preserve the original evidence boundary and endpoint. Bind every record to source/version, valid-time interval, missingness reason and a fixture or collection permission. When fields or labels are absent, design a synthetic or owned-system fixture and report the gap.

Match information, tuning, observation and resource budgets. Define an absolute acceptance floor and minimum meaningful improvement before collecting the final test results. Reject the thesis if the benefit disappears on an untouched partition, if the resource-normalized baseline dominates it or if a declared invariant fails. Choose numerical floors with the mission owner; this dossier does not invent measured thresholds.

**Adverse-case matrix:** Changed collection pipeline; concurrent intervention; lower event rate; adverse subgroup. Choose the cases relevant to this mechanism and explain any exclusion. Add a negative control in which the intervention should have no effect. Preserve ambiguous outcomes instead of assigning unsupported truth labels.

**Graduate investigation:** Confounding; metric gaming; rare events; correlated controls; nonstationary environment. Write a rival explanation for any apparent improvement; identify the smallest additional observation that distinguishes it from the proposed mechanism. Perform a sensitivity analysis over uncertain assumptions and a leave-one-environment/scenario-out evaluation. # NIGHTSHIFT · Image credits

This site uses photographs, publisher product images and actual software screenshots. No synthetic photographs or invented tool screenshots were used. Diagrams are labeled conceptual; synthetic research figures have their own input contracts.

## Locally hosted photographs and screenshot

All three files are reproduced with their original image bytes and displayed with responsive scaling **without cropping**. Their individual **CC BY-SA 4.0** licenses remain in effect; source creators do not endorse this site. [License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). [Machine-readable digests](../data/visuals/assets.json).

| Image | Creator / attribution | Source and date |
|---|---|---|
| [Flipper Zero photograph](photos/flipper-zero.jpg) | Turbospok | [Wikimedia Commons file page](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Flipper_Zero.jpg), 27 May 2022 |
| [Proxmark3 legacy hardware photograph](photos/proxmark3.png) | Proxmark.com; Commons uploader Coldheader | [Wikimedia Commons file page](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:PM3-Trans.png), dated 1 April 2021 |
| [Proxmark3 RDV4 help-screen screenshot](photos/proxmark-help.png) | Turbospok | [Wikimedia Commons file page](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Proxmark_help.png), 16 September 2021 |

The Flipper photo's Commons page flags incidental copyrighted dolphin artwork and cautions about cropping to focus on it. The site preserves the complete photograph. The Proxmark hardware photograph shows an older design; it is not presented as a photograph of every current model. The help screenshot illustrates an older interface and is not a current-version compatibility guarantee.

| Image | Credit | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Chameleon Ultra product overview | RfidResearchGroup / Chameleon Ultra contributors | [Project README](https://github.com/RfidResearchGroup/ChameleonUltra), `docs/images/ultra-overview.png` |
